Subject: Pilot bridge proposal — phased option for timeboxed eval

Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for the call this morning — great to hear how Clockwork is evaluating retrieval-augmented generation for your internal search flows. Per our discussion, I put together two short options for bridging the pilot without pausing progress: a small-credit top-up, and a phased timebox extension with milestone checks. Both are attached as a quick quote (redwood_pilot_quote_v2.xlsx).

High level:
- Option A — Credit top-up: $12k in credits to cover expected additional tokens and a week of engineering time; auto-applies to current pilot.
- Option B — Phased extension (recommended): 4-week extension split into two 2-week milestones. $25k flat bridge fee with $15k applied as credits if conversion (purchase) happens within 30 days after the pilot ends. Includes continued access to the same Dedicated capacity profile and one prioritized on-call during integration weeks.

If Procurement prefers a PO path, I attached a one-page PO template you can drop into your system (Clockwork_PO_Template.pdf). Rafael and Neha are looped in for any finance/discount questions.

Can you confirm which path you prefer so I can lock terms and send a DocuSign?

Thanks,
Ava Chen

My suggested counter: convert the $25k bridge fee into a partially refundable bridge that converts to $15k credit on purchase; refundable portion ($10k) is returned if Clockwork cancels before the second milestone starts.
